title: microloma tenuifolium
intro: Microloma tenuifolium, commonly known as Chinese wormwood, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, traditionally used in Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Microloma tenuifolium include its antimalarial, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions such as fever, malaria, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to induce sweating and relieve fever, as well as its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Microloma tenuifolium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
